title: Even as Thou Said'st, O Christ
description: Even as Thou Said'st, O Christ in Tonic Solfa to QUAM DILECTA, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns from the Greek Office Books (Paisley, 1904), headed “Ode VI. of Cosmas The Monk”.
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Sixes (6.6.6.6), and this page sets them to QUAM DILECTA; any other Sixes tune fits them as well.
underlay: Even as thou said'st, O Christ, The Ho-ly Spir-it came, And now our hearts pos-sess The knowl-edge of Thy name.

lines: Even as thou said'st, O Christ,
And from that Source of Life
And to the Christ, His Son,

source: John Brownlie, Hymns from the Greek Office Books (1904)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns from the Greek Office Books; set to QUAM DILECTA by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
